{{Quote|When I got jumped by pirates off Q'mara, I rigged up some portable shield generators and simply let the lead pirate waste his first shot with the deck-clearer. Since they have such a slow rate of fire, it took us no time to seize him, his weapon&hellip; and the rest of the boarding party.|[[Qellrin]]|<ref name="PG">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>}}
'''Q'mara''', located in the [[Q'mara system/Legends|Q'mara system]] of the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], was a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a number of shabby [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]], where all manner of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and thugs sought illicit employment. Juvex nobles frequented Q'mara's houses of ill repute; foolish ones were drawn into its subterranean [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] and [[Spice/Legends|spice]] dens, sometimes never to return. [[Qellrin]] was attacked by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] near Q'mara.
